    Properties of the colimit extension #

    For a functor Φ : D_fin → Mod A, the extension F = Extension.functor Φ of (3.6) extends Φ (Extension.isoOfFin), is k-linear when Φ is, is faithful and exact when Φ is, and satisfies dim F(T) = dim T for infinite-dimensional T. Additivity and colimit preservation are in Extension.Preserves.
